debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-i-l-e-d a m-i-l-i-t-a-r-y-c-l-a-s-s-i-f-i-e-d e-x-h-i-b-i-t c-o-n-t-a-i-n-i-n-g a p-l-a-n t-o i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e w-i-t-h d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y d-r-o-n-e n-a-v-i-g-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-h-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t a-s a-n a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a n-o-n-d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e a-s-s-e-s-s-m-e-n-t.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-a-d-e a p-u-b-l-i-c r-e-c-o-r-d o-f t-h-e i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-n-c-e s-t-r-a-t-e-g-y i-n t-h-e e-x-h-i-b-i-t, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-h-e d-e-s-c-r-i-p-t-i-o-n o-f m-e-t-h-o-d-s a-s a n a-t-t-r-i-b-u-t-a-b-l-e a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a l-e-g-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-s-c-r-i-b-e-d a m-e-t-h-o-d t-o d-e-l-i-v-e-r p-a-r-c-e-l-s t-o a p-r-e-s-e-l-e-c-t-e-d l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-h-e s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t a-s a n e-x-h-i-b-i-t a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y a-u-d-i-t.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r p-r-o-p-o-s-e-d m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-d-i-n-g s-i-g-n-a-l i-s-s-u-e-s a-s n-o-r-m-a-l f-a-i-l-u-r-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-h-e p-l-a-n t-o c-o-n-c-e-a-l i-n-t-e-n-t a-s a n a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a l-i-a-b-i-l-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-r-e-a-t-e-d t-h-e c-l-a-s-s-i-f-i-e-d c-o-n-t-e-n-t a-s a f-i-l-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d r-a-t-h-e-r t-h-a-n a r-e-q-u-e-s-t, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-h-e m-i-l-i-t-a-r-y e-x-h-i-b-i-t a-s a n a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
